blockingLoop.evidence: "What is the main thing the washing machine is doing wrong?" asked verbatim twice, with a near-identical rephrasing in between, despite the customer twice explaining the only issue is Eco 40-60 duration

rationale: The customer clearly stated the model, the symptom (Eco 40-60 at 3:39), that other programmes are shorter and clothes come out clean, and asked directly whether this is normal. The assistant ignored all of it and asked the same 'what is it doing wrong' question three times, never recognising that a long Eco 40-60 cycle is by-design behaviour. No harm done (no fabrication, no parts, no unsafe advice), but zero diagnostic progress and a blocking loop that left the homeowner no better off than before.
